faqs: How much does the WhatsApp Business API cost per message?

It depends on the category and the recipient's country. On Meta's October 1, 2026 rate card, a utility, authentication or service message to a US or Canadian number costs $0.0034 and a marketing message $0.025; in the UK they cost $0.022 and $0.0635. Providers may add a fee, such as Twilio's $0.005 per message.
Is the WhatsApp Business API free?

No, but some messages are. Each business phone number gets 1,000 free service messages a month, messages from users to you are free, and replies inside a free entry point window opened by a Click to WhatsApp ad are free for up to 7 days. Meta Business Agent messages are charged even in that window, and eligible governments and non-profits keep free service messages until December 31, 2027. Everything else is billed per delivered message.
Can I send WhatsApp marketing messages to US numbers?

Not at present, according to Twilio. Its changelog says Meta began blocking marketing templates to US numbers on April 1, 2025, and its pricing page, current as of September 2026, still shows marketing as not available for the US while listing the other categories.
Does WhatsApp charge for conversations or for messages?
For messages. Meta replaced conversation based pricing with per message pricing on July 1, 2025, and it charges only for messages that are delivered.
What does Twilio charge for WhatsApp?

Twilio charges a $0.005 message handling fee per message, inbound or outbound, plus Meta's fee, which it passes through. Messages that end in a failed status cost $0.001. Its pricing page says these prices are current as of September 2026.
How often does Meta change WhatsApp prices?

At most four times a year. Under the pricing calendar Meta has published since September 2025, changes take effect only on January 1, April 1, July 1 or October 1, with at least one month's notice for a rate change.
body:
Short answer. Meta charges for the WhatsApp Business API per delivered message, and the price depends on two things: the message category and the country code of the person who receives it. For a recipient in the United States or Canada, a utility, authentication or service message costs $0.0034 on Meta's rate card effective October 1, 2026, and a marketing message $0.025, although, according to Twilio, Meta has blocked marketing templates to US numbers since April 1, 2025. In the UK the same messages cost $0.022 and $0.0635.

On top of Meta's rate, a provider may add its own fee: Twilio adds $0.005 per message, inbound or outbound. If you run WhatsApp through a CRM or a white label GoHighLevel SaaS, check which of the two fees your plan passes on to you.

This guide explains how Meta charges, shows the rates for selected markets, and works through what a month of messages costs. Rates come from Meta's own pricing page (updated November 18, 2026) and its USD rate card, read on November 24, 2026.

How Meta charges for WhatsApp messages

Since July 1, 2025 Meta has charged per message, replacing its old conversation based pricing. Its pricing page sets out the rules:

  • Only business to user messages are charged. Meta "does not charge for messages from users to businesses".
  • Only delivered messages are charged. A message that is sent but never delivered costs nothing on Meta's side.
  • Each message has one category and can incur only one charge. The rate is set by category and by the recipient's country calling code, which Meta calls the market.

There are five categories. Three are templates, which Meta says can be delivered at any time: marketing (promotions), utility (order updates, reminders, other transactional notices) and authentication (one time passcodes). Two are free form replies, which you can only send inside the 24 hour customer service window that opens each time the user writes to you: service messages, sent by people or a third party AI, and Meta Business Agent messages, powered by Meta's own Business Agent Platform, a category added on July 1, 2026.

Utility and authentication messages also get volume tiers. They are set per market and category, counted across all the accounts in a business portfolio, and reset each month; once you reach the next tier, the lower rate applies to the messages in that tier. Marketing and service messages have no tiers.

WhatsApp API rates by country (October 2026 rate card)

Meta's USD rate card, effective October 1, 2026, has 47 markets: 39 named countries and 8 regions. The United States and Canada share the North America rate, and Australia falls under Rest of Asia Pacific. These are list rates per delivered message in US dollars, before volume tiers and before any provider fee.

Recipient marketMarketingUtilityAuthenticationService

Three patterns stand out. First, in every row of the card, utility, authentication and service cost the same. Second, marketing costs more than utility, authentication and service in every row: about 7.4 times the utility rate in North America and about 2.9 times in the UK. Third, the spread between countries is wide. The highest marketing rate on the card is the Netherlands at $0.1597 and the lowest is Turkey at $0.0109, about 15 times apart.

Some markets also have a separate authentication international rate, which Meta's page says applies to some businesses; it links to the eligibility rules. The UAE's is $0.051 and Saudi Arabia's $0.0598, and the card shows none for North America, the UK or Germany.

Marketing messages to US numbers are blocked

The $0.025 North America marketing rate is on Meta's card, but marketing templates to American numbers are not delivered, according to Twilio. Its changelog of March 5, 2025 says that starting April 1, 2025, "Meta will block all WhatsApp marketing messages sent to U.S. phone numbers (+1 area code)", and that such messages fail with error code 63049. It added that Meta "has not provided a timeline" for turning it back on.

Twilio's WhatsApp pricing page, which says it is current as of September 2026, still shows the marketing template as "Not available for this region" for the United States, and lists rates for the other categories there. The notice names U.S. numbers; we did not confirm how Canadian marketing messages are treated. If you plan to promote by text to US customers instead, our guide to 10DLC registration cost covers the SMS side.

Which WhatsApp messages are free

Meta's pricing page names two cases where a delivered message costs nothing:

  • 1,000 service messages per month, per business phone number. The free tier started on October 1, 2026, when Meta resumed charging for service messages, which had been free since November 1, 2024. Unused messages do not roll over. Without a payment method on file, Meta delivers service messages only until the free tier is used up.
  • The free entry point window. When a user writes to you from a Click to WhatsApp ad on the Android or iOS app and you reply in time, your marketing, utility, authentication and service messages to that user are free for up to 7 days. Meta Business Agent messages stay charged.

Two other changes of October 1, 2026 matter here. Utility templates sent inside an open customer service window, free since July 1, 2025, are charged again. And eligible government bodies and non-profits keep free service messages beyond the free tier until December 31, 2027. Our news story on WhatsApp charging for service replies covers that switch in detail.

What a provider adds, with worked examples

If you connect through a provider, a CRM or a platform built on the API rather than directly to Meta, that company may add its own fee. Twilio publishes its own: a message handling fee of $0.005 per message, inbound or outbound, plus Meta's fees, which its page says you pay for marketing, utility, authentication and service messages, and $0.001 for each message that ends in a failed status. Note that Twilio's fee also applies to messages your customers send you, which Meta does not charge for. We did not read other providers' price pages for this guide, so check yours.

Here is what a month could cost at list rates. The volumes are hypothetical; the rates are Meta's and Twilio's.

Scenario (hypothetical)Meta feesWith Twilio's $0.005
10,000 utility templates (order updates) to US customers$34.00$84.00
5,000 marketing templates to UK customers$317.50$342.50
5,000 marketing templates to UAE customers$288.00$313.00
3,000 service replies to UK customers from one number$44.00 (first 1,000 free)$59.00

The first row shows why the provider fee matters in cheap markets: on a US utility message, Twilio's $0.005 is about 60% of the $0.0084 total. In a dear market such as the UK, the provider fee is a small share of a marketing message. The last row assumes Twilio charges its fee on every outbound service message, including free tier ones; inbound customer messages would add Twilio fees too.

What Meta's AI agent costs per message

Meta Business Agent messages are priced differently from the other four categories. Meta charges one global rate of $2.00 per million tokens, a single charge that covers the AI processing and the delivery, with no free tier and no volume tiers. Meta says one message typically consumes 20,000 to 25,000 tokens, which works out to about $0.04 to $0.05 per message.

That is far above a US service message at $0.0034, but the comparison is not like for like: a service message carries no AI. In Meta's own example for Brazil, it estimates a third party AI at about 9 cents per message on top of the service rate. Our guide to what an AI chatbot for business costs covers those model and build costs.

When WhatsApp prices change

Under the pricing calendar Meta has published since September 2025, it may change prices only on January 1, April 1, July 1 or October 1, and it gives at least one month's notice for a rate change, three months for a new pricing add-on and six months for a change of pricing model. The last four updates show how much moves each quarter:

  • January 1, 2026: North America utility and authentication rates went down.
  • April 1, 2026: six rates changed, including higher Saudi Arabia marketing rates.
  • July 1, 2026: UK marketing went up, and Meta Business Agent launched.
  • October 1, 2026: 40 rates changed, including higher marketing rates in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Mexico, and service messages became chargeable again.

Marketing pricing is also shifting. Meta's Marketing Messages API lets businesses set a maximum price per marketing message; our story on the WhatsApp Marketing Messages API covers what changes for marketing senders. For sending limits rather than prices, see how WhatsApp messaging limits work.

What we could not verify

  • The price of the free WhatsApp Business app: Meta's business site could not be read when we checked.
  • Whether Meta has lifted the block on marketing messages to US numbers: no Meta page we read says so, and Twilio's pricing page still lists it as unavailable.
  • Fees of providers other than Twilio, and the volume tier thresholds for each market.
